FatFs R0.15a by ChaN (1-clause BSD-style licence, see LICENSE.txt).
Upstream: http://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/arc/ff15a.zip (no VCS; archive dated 2024-11-22)
sha256(ff15a.zip) = 74737b1cafa1a67a3f722dd0d1a44767c5b54d37b6300ad3825a904cbe88fc3c
Files copied from source/: ff.c ff.h ffunicode.c diskio.h 00readme.txt
Local changes in ffconf.h: FF_CODE_PAGE 437, FF_USE_LFN 1 (static buffer), FF_FS_NORTC 1.
The disk I/O layer lives in src/hal/sd_diskio.cpp (SDHC driver).
Local changes in ff.c / ff.h (marked "OpenTracker"; tests/fatfs_alloc_test.cpp):
- FSI_TrailSig 498 -> 508: backport of the R0.15b fix ("FatFs fails to load the
  FsInfo in FAT32 volumes", appeared at R0.15a).
- create_chain resumes a stretch's free-cluster scan where the last one ended
  (FATFS.scan_clst, seeded from FSInfo's next free cluster at mount). Without it
  a file rewritten in its old cluster hole and grown past it scans the FAT from
  the hole across every used cluster up to free space, on each rewrite. Still
  the same in R0.16.
